_comment: Single source of truth for the blog. The /blog page and the 'from the blog' card on the landing page both render from this file — add a post here and it shows up in both. Newest first; the page sorts by date anyway. 'body' is a list of paragraphs (plain text, no HTML).

posts.title: Placeholder: the first post
posts.summary: A short line that shows up under the headline. Swap this out for the real thing.
body: This is a placeholder post so the blog has something in it. Edit posts.json to replace it.
Each string in "body" becomes its own paragraph. There's no markdown and no build step — what you type is what shows up.

posts.title: Placeholder: something about boats
posts.summary: Another placeholder. Delete it once there's a real post to put here.
body: Posts are sorted newest first by the "date" field, which is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string.
The landing page shows the three most recent headlines; the blog page shows all of them.
